pages.text: TFMG makes rotation from fuel with engines, and electricity with its own circuit system. Both plug into normal Create networks.

pages.title: Regular Engine
pages.text: Assembled from a body plus matching Engine Cylinders. Click it with a Shaft to set the rotation output. Needs lubrication oil from an Oil Can.

pages.title: Large Engine
pages.text: Burns less refined fuel (diesel, kerosene, naphtha, furnace gas). Needs air in and CO2 pumped out to an Exhaust. A Shaft goes on like a steam engine.

Radial and Turbine Engines are the other types. An Engine Controller linked to the engine sets speed and direction. Fuel comes from $(l:industry/tfmg_oil)TFMG Oil$(/l); engine rotation is ordinary rotation and obeys $(l:create_basics/stress)Stress$(/l).

pages.title: Generator
pages.text: The source of TFMG electricity. A source gives Voltage and Power; devices have Resistance, and current is voltage divided by resistance.

Blocks share a $(thing)group$(): members of one group split the voltage, the rest keep all of it. Change a block's group with the $(item)Configuration Wrench$(). A Diode, Potentiometer, Switch or Transformer starts a subnetwork.

pages.title: Cable Hubs
pages.text: Wire hubs and insulators with copper, aluminum or constantan spools. A Voltmeter (Electric Gauge) shows what a part carries.

TFMG's cable connectors can import and export FE, so TFMG circuits can touch FE machines. Its wires are separate from Crafts & Additions wires. See $(l:industry/power_compared)Rotation vs Electricity$(/l).
